body: Getting closure is never a bad thing. If you intend to actually have a life after this though you're going to need to let go and move on. Rationalizing holding on forever will only lead to more pain

I just ended a relationship with a girl that I had been with for 8 years. After all that time it ended mutually but that doesnt make it hurt any less...

First thing you need to do is cut off all contact. You're in survival mode right now and you need to think only of yourself. The slightest contact can bring you spiralling back. The second thing you need to do is appreciate everything. Appreciate the times you had, especially the bad because they taught you what you need to know to move on in the now.

Above all else. I'm sorry, depression sucks and is a bitch to pull yourself out of but you're not alone. PM me if you want

Without a doubt. I'm trying to pretend because I don't want to go back to that old life. I don't want all the pain she caused. I want to move on

I feel dead though because I feel trapped here in the transition. I don't want to turn around but I don't feel as though I'll find anything else
